key_insight: The paper turns two entanglement tests—PPT and CCNR—into quantum circuits so entanglement can be detected through executable hardware-friendly operations.
engineering_relevance: It provides a hybrid quantum-classical workflow for scalable entanglement checking on near-term quantum devices, with potential use in quantum verification and state characterization.
method: Encode quantum states into circuit-ready forms
Use SWAP-based circuit constructions to realize partial transpose and realignment
Estimate trace norms with an improved variational quantum SVD subroutine
evidence_signal: The abstract claims a complete algorithmic pathway and improved efficiency for entanglement detection, but it does not report numerical experiments or benchmark results.
watch_item: Practical performance will depend on circuit depth, noise sensitivity, and the accuracy of the variational singular-value estimation on intermediate-scale hardware.
paper_title: Quantum Circuit Realization of the PPT and CCNR Criteria
